q: Does it have classes or a character roster?

q: What does a run actually ask you to do?
a: Roll the shared movement die in the game room, deal with the event, bring idols back to unlock the next roll, and repeat. When the token reaches the center, carry the Game Master’s soul idol back and seal it. Eisenfang’s guide also says the table then speaks “Invokyr” into the microphone. That spoken step is a community report, not a line in the launch post.

q: Why does Steam list Free To Play if the game costs money?
a: The appdetails payload on 21 October 2026 includes Free To Play among the genres and also sets is_free to false, with a US price. The game is a paid Early Access title. The genre tag is metadata, not a free download.

q: When does the launch discount end?
a: On 21 October 2026 the US store API still showed 25% off, $12.99 down to $9.74. SteamDB’s price history called it an introductory offer ending 22 October 2026. Check the store page before you buy. Ludogram has said the price can rise as content ships.

q: Where do the damage numbers come from?
